# Unit test for function file_name_check
def test_file_name_check():
    # Valid file names
    assert file_name_check("document.txt") == "Yes"
    assert file_name_check("program.exe") == "Yes"
    assert file_name_check("library.dll") == "Yes"
    assert file_name_check("file123.txt") == "Yes"
    assert file_name_check("a.dll") == "Yes"

    # Invalid extensions
    assert file_name_check("document.pdf") == "No"
    assert file_name_check("file.TXT") == "No"
    assert file_name_check("file") == "No"

    # Invalid number of dots
    assert file_name_check("archive.tar.txt") == "No"
    assert file_name_check("file.") == "No"
    assert file_name_check(".txt") == "No"

    # Base name must start with a letter
    assert file_name_check("1file.txt") == "No"
    assert file_name_check("_file.exe") == "No"

    # Base name cannot contain more than three digits
    assert file_name_check("file1234.txt") == "No"
    assert file_name_check("a1b2c3d4.dll") == "No"

# Unit test for function file_name_check
def test_file_name_check():
    # Valid file names
    assert file_name_check('document.txt') == 'Yes'
    assert file_name_check('app.exe') == 'Yes'
    assert file_name_check('library.dll') == 'Yes'
    assert file_name_check('file123.txt') == 'Yes'  # Exactly 3 digits

    # Invalid suffixes
    assert file_name_check('document.pdf') == 'No'
    assert file_name_check('document.TXT') == 'No'

    # Missing or multiple dots
    assert file_name_check('document') == 'No'
    assert file_name_check('archive.tar.txt') == 'No'

    # Empty base name
    assert file_name_check('.txt') == 'No'

    # Base name must start with a letter
    assert file_name_check('1file.txt') == 'No'
    assert file_name_check('_file.exe') == 'No'

    # More than 3 digits in the base name
    assert file_name_check('file1234.txt') == 'No'

    # Empty and malformed names
    assert file_name_check('') == 'No'
    assert file_name_check('file.') == 'No'
